timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Of course, I feel very happy. I'm very honored to receive this award and I have
to sincerely thank Fortune Times for selecting me as a recipient. It's nice to
be recognized after close to two decades of hard work and effort that I put
into the business. Over the last two decades, I have to say I'm very privileged
to work with some great mentors who have really taught me and guided me along
the way, as well as had the opportunity to work in businesses where I've had the
chance to grow and contribute towards the businesses future. I, you know, some
of the great business leaders that have worked with, you know, past and present,
actually include, you know, hailing from a family business, my own late grandfather,
as well as my father as well. You know, two of them have been very, very influential
in my life. My grandfather, you know, taught me, you know, the importance of having
good core values. And aside from being just a good businessman, I realized that
it is much more important to be a good person with an honest heart. As my father,
I think he taught me, you know, the meaning of working hard and persevering, as
well as having a strong fighting spirit and being able to handle pressure, you
know, in the right manner. So for this, you know, I'm really grateful to both of
these gentlemen, I think, for the influence they've had on my life, as well as all the
other wonderful business leaders that have had the privilege of working with.
And I will, of course, would also like to thank our staff, you know, who have
just been amazing, you know, this includes both my former colleagues, as well as my
current ones. They have worked closely with me, tirelessly, you know, and very
dedicated. And, you know, it's thanks to them that I'm also attaining this
recognition today. Yeah, about the, you know, future visions. I mean, wow, I mean, lots
of visions for the future, right? Obviously, you know, we all hope for more peace in
the world and greater harmony across ethnicities and religions. You know, but
specifically regarding, I think, the future and the business world, I certainly
the future lies strongly around connectivity, you know, I think, and also
disruption to a certain extent. We live in a very disruptive world right now, where,
you know, established business models are being challenged. You know, technology is
speeding up the pace of change and, you know, globalization is also changing age,
old paradigms. So I think, you know, we all, as businesses, need to constantly
innovate and find new and better ways to do things. As for us at CDL, being a real
state company, I think we need to embrace technology in a bigger manner and harness
it in order to provide better solutions to the real state sector. I think this
is very important for us to continue to keep our competitive edge. And on this
front, we are already doing that. I mean, we started investing in companies. I
think that will help us, you know, to maintain a competitive edge in this sector.
And aside from, I think, you know, obviously technology as an enabler, another
very important aspect that is a key part of CDL's DNA is our sustainability. I
think, you know, this, we've all seen the damage and the change that's
happening to this world, you know, global warming, everything. We owe it to
ourselves, you know, to really, you know, create a more sustainable world, you
know, since we all live in this place, create a more sustainable environment for
the future. And at CDL, we've always believed that we should conserve as we
construct, you know, and this is very much, we'll always remain an important part
of our DNA and our future drive. Thank you.

youtube_description:
Mr Sherman Kwek is the Deputy Chief Executive Officer of City Developments Limited（CDL）.  He was awarded the Asia Top Entrepreneurs Awards Promising Business Leader Award 2016 by Fortune Times.

The Interviewer asked questions:
1. What are your thoughts on winning the award? What does this mean to yourself and your company?
2. What are your visions for the future?

Interviewed by Fortune Times
